_source: Transfer market, confirmed by Carlos Oct 9, 2026 (09:14, 09:40, 09:48, 09:57). Numbers marked PROPOSAL are for balancing. See claude/transfer-market-draft.md.

importance._note: Fair price = market value x importance x form (Carlos, 09:40). Rank by rating within the squad. Multipliers PROPOSAL.

form._note: Good form makes the club want to keep him (Carlos, 09:40). 1 + slope x (form - neutral), clamped. PROPOSAL.

acceptance._note: Offer / demand: 100% or more closes the deal (Carlos, 09:14). Linear to 0% at 70%. Shown 0-100% in whole numbers (09:40).

responses._note: How far off the offer is decides the response (Carlos, 09:48). PROPOSAL shares. Under zeroAt: offended, walks away. After a plain 'no' to a bid, the bidder improves it 50%, holds it 30%, withdraws 20% (PROPOSAL).

years._note: Preferred contract length by age; each year away from it counts as 5% less money. PROPOSAL.

bonuses._note: Bonuses lower what he asks from that club (folded into the wage demand): his academy club or a former club 5%, Loyal renewing 10%, Diva asks 10% more. PROPOSAL.

bids._note: Listing brings 0-5 bids depending on how useful he is (Carlos, 09:14). Bids 0.85-1.10x value (approved Oct 8). A bidder's hidden maximum is its bid x 1.00-1.25. PROPOSAL.

windows._note: Summer 8 weeks before the season, winter 4 weeks at the halfway point; deadline rush x3 on the last 3 days. PROPOSAL.

ai._note: AI market rules. PROPOSAL. Needs: a short position group, a starter more than 3 below the club's level, or else an upgrade on the weakest starter. Scouts look at players rated between the need and need + 8. Selling: at the start of a window an AI club lists players beyond 28 (weakest over 21 first), and if its wages are above 80% of its expected income it lists its most expensive players outside its best 3 until the excess is covered.

loans._note: Loans to the end of the season, no buy option in v1. The borrowing club pays 0, 50 or 100% of his wage plus a loan fee of 0-10% of value. PROPOSAL.
